import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('ers_food_expenditure_series_nominal.xlsx', sheet_name='Nominal expenditures', header=1)
year_col = [c for c in df.columns if 'Year' in str(c)][0]
fafh_col = [c for c in df.columns if 'Total food-away-from-home expenditures' in str(c)][0]

df[year_col] = pd.to_numeric(df[year_col], errors='coerce')
df[fafh_col] = pd.to_numeric(df[fafh_col], errors='coerce')

surpassed = df[df[fafh_col] > 1000000].sort_values(by=year_col)
result = str(int(surpassed.iloc[0][year_col]))

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('ers_food_expenditure_series_nominal.xlsx', sheet_name='Nominal expenditures', header=1)
year_col = [c for c in df.columns if 'Year' in str(c)][0]
alc_col = [c for c in df.columns if 'Alcohol sales at eating and drinking places' in str(c)][0]

df[year_col] = pd.to_numeric(df[year_col], errors='coerce')
df[alc_col] = pd.to_numeric(df[alc_col], errors='coerce')

val_2019 = df[df[year_col] == 2019][alc_col].values[0]
val_2020 = df[df[year_col] == 2020][alc_col].values[0]
result = 'yes' if val_2020 < val_2019 else 'no'

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('ers_food_expenditure_series_nominal.xlsx', sheet_name='Nominal expenditures', header=1)
year_col = [c for c in df.columns if 'Year' in str(c)][0]
alc_afh_col = [c for c in df.columns if 'Total alcohol-away-from-home sales' in str(c)][0]

df[year_col] = pd.to_numeric(df[year_col], errors='coerce')
df[alc_afh_col] = pd.to_numeric(df[alc_afh_col], errors='coerce')

filtered = df[(df[year_col] >= 1997) & (df[year_col] <= 2025)]
result = int((filtered[alc_afh_col] > 100000).sum())

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('ers_food_expenditure_series_nominal.xlsx', sheet_name='Nominal expenditures', header=1)
year_col = [c for c in df.columns if 'Year' in str(c)][0]
fsr_col = [c for c in df.columns if 'Food sales at full-service restaurants' in str(c)][0]

df[year_col] = pd.to_numeric(df[year_col], errors='coerce')
df[fsr_col] = pd.to_numeric(df[fsr_col], errors='coerce')

top3 = df.dropna(subset=[year_col, fsr_col]).nlargest(3, fsr_col)
result = [str(int(y)) for y in top3[year_col].tolist()]
